# Launch post — draft 1

I have been building a small tool for the last two weeks.

It does one thing: ~~it keeps your tasks in a file~~ ++it keeps your tasks where both you and your AI can see them++.

[[AI: suggest 3 alternative opening lines, each under 12 words]]

## What it is not

It is not another project manager. There is no login, no server, no sync service.
